english.title: Make false statement to obtain, renew or amend registration of exempt facility
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) made a statement for the purpose of

(A)_[obtaining]_
(B)_[renewing]_
(C)_[amending]_

the registration of an exempt facility, namely **(..SPECIFY FACILITY..), which you knew to be, or recklessly made such a statement which was, false or misleading in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSEHOOD..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 38(4)(b)(iii) and 39(4) of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2016.
